newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct air freight soars 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct air freight soars 15 percent.

text.p: China moved 947,000 tonnes of air freight between January and October, up 15.5 percent from the same period of 1995, but total freight volume was unchanged, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Total freight volume was steady at 2.2 billion tonnes between January and October, said the newspaper, which is published by the official China Daily.

Of the freight total, railways transported 1.350 billion tonnes, up 1.5 percent year-on-year while trucks hauled 370 million tonnes, down 3.7 percent, the newspaper quoted figures from the State Statistical Information and Consultancy Service Centre as saying.
Ships carried 513 million tonnes, down 1.4 percent.
